# Node self-test: the automatic edit (`autoedit`)

Wired into the node acceptance run (`backend/apps/compute/selftests/`, page «آزمونِ خودکارِ سرورِ پردازش»): `selftests/autoedit.py` registers `autoedit_words`
(kind `asr.transcribe`, after `tts_piper`) and `autoedit_mix` (a *virtual* test: it queues its own `edit.render` job because the render's input files must be
registered with `transfer` so the node can download them; it asks again at every step; after `edit_render`), and the JSON block at the end of this file
registers `autoedit_matte` (kind `edit.matte`). The first two are skipped - with the name of the missing kind - on an agent that does not advertise the whole
pipeline (`asr.transcribe`, `edit.matte`, `edit.render`), never failed; the matte test needs `edit.matte`. The pass logic is the same pure functions as below
(`services/editing/selftest_autoedit.py`: `check_mix`, `check_words`, `check_matte`).

The same checks run from the command line: `manage.py autoedit_selftest [--only render_mix,asr,matte] [--json]`
(exit code 0 = passed, 1 = failed, 2 = waiting: no processing server online - ask again later).

Three small REAL jobs, each judged by looking at what comes back:

## render_mix - job kind `edit.render` (the editor's final render, NVENC when the card can)
* Payload: built by `noderender.build()` from `selftest_autoedit.mix_project()` - a 10 s project: a person speaking at 3-5 s on camera (synthetic
  speech-like signal, nothing of anybody's), a "music" band-noise bed at 7 kHz all along, **no ducking key** (the default must apply), master loudness
  -14 LUFS. Media is generated into a temp folder by `make_media()`.
* Pass (`check_mix`): the file has a picture and a sound, length 10 s +-0.7; `audioqc.analyze` finds no doubled speech / out-of-phase channels /
  music over the voice; the bed is at least 8 dB lower while the person speaks than in the open (the default ducking is really applied); loudness within
  -17...-11 LUFS.

## asr - job kind `voice.asr`
* Payload: a Persian sentence synthesised by the site's own voice (`tts.get_tts_provider("fa")`) -> 16 kHz mono wav -> `captions.transcribe_wav`.
  Skipped (not failed) when the site has no local voice.
* Pass (`check_words`): at least 3 words, start times rising, all inside the clip, at least 2 of the sentence's own words recognised; the engine must be `node`.

## matte - job kind `edit.matte` (Robust Video Matting on the GPU)
* Payload: `{"video": "clip.mp4", "fps": 12, "duration": 2, "size": [320, 240]}` with a 2 s `testsrc2` clip.
* Pass (`check_matte`): a video of the same size (+-8 px) and length (+-0.8 s) comes back. (A test pattern has no person, so the content of the matte is not judged.)

The pass/fail logic is covered without a node by `services/tests_autoedit_selftest.py` (a correct render passes, ducking off fails, the old doubled mix fails).

## بلوکِ `autoedit_matte` (برای `docs_loader`)

بلوکِ زیر را `docs_loader` برمی‌دارد و «جداسازیِ پس‌زمینهٔ ویدیو» را با هر نسخهٔ تازهٔ عامل و هر شب اجرا می‌کند (فایلِ ورودی یک کلیپِ ۲ثانیه‌ایِ ۱۵ کیلوبایتی است). دو آزمونِ دیگرِ این ویژگی در `selftests/autoedit.py` ثبت شده‌اند (بالا).

```json
{"key": "autoedit_matte", "label": "جداسازیِ پس‌زمینهٔ ویدیو (تدوینِ خودکار)", "group": "video", "kind": "edit.matte", "payload": {"video": "clip.mp4", "fps": 12, "duration": 2, "size": [320, 240]}, "files_b64": {"clip.mp4": ""}, "timeout_s": 600, "optional": false, "deep": false, "gpu_required": false, "order": 160, "requires": {"kinds": ["edit.matte"]}, "check": {"outputs_min": 1, "output_ext": [".mp4"], "min_bytes": 1000}, "requeue_kinds": ["edit.matte"], "describe": "دو ثانیه ویدیو با الگوی آزمایشی؛ ماتِ همان اندازه و طول باید برگردد (محتوای مات سنجیده نمی‌شود)"}
```
